description: This file defines the singleton class 'MacNodeModeCoordinator' responsible for managing the lifecycle and connection process of a macOS node in an OpenClaw distributed system. It handles starting/stopping tasks, managing gateway sessions, reacting to configuration changes, and maintaining connection state with the gateway, including reconnection logic and permission management.

classes.name: MacNodeModeCoordinator
classes.description: A singleton class that manages the lifecycle and network connection of a macOS node within the OpenClaw framework, including session management, configuration updates, and event handling.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the background task to maintain the node's connection to the gateway.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Cancels the ongoing connection task and disconnects the session.

methods.name: setPreferredGatewayStableID
methods.description: Sets the preferred stable ID for the gateway and disconnects the current session to trigger reconnection with updated preferences.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Core asynchronous method that maintains a persistent connection to the gateway, handling reconnection, configuration changes, and session events.

methods.name: currentCaps
methods.description: Determines the current capabilities based on user preferences and configuration.

methods.name: currentPermissions
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current permission statuses.

methods.name: currentCommands
methods.description: Generates a list of commands supported based on current capabilities.

methods.name: buildSessionBox
methods.description: Creates a WebSocket session box if the URL scheme is secure WebSocket (wss).
